description: Robinhood Markets, Inc. was founded in 2013 on the belief that everyone should be welcome to participate in the financial system, and it is creating modern financial services platforms for everyone, regardless of their wealth, income or background, with the mission to democratize finance for all, using technology to provide access to the financial system in a way that is simple and convenient for its customers, and it believes the financial system should be built to work for everyone, which is why it creates products that let customers start investing at their own pace, on their own terms, with a simple design and an intuitive interface so that customers are empowered to achieve their goals. It started with a revolutionary, bold brand and design in the Robinhood app which makes investing approachable for millions, and over the last decade it has disrupted and changed the industry, becoming the first U.S. retail broker to offer commission-free stock trading.
